infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ForkCast uses your location to find nearby restaurants and provide personalized recommendations.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: ForkCast needs optional access to your contacts only when you ask it to import guests or share a reservation.
